v2 route files import contract objects from @/lib/api/contracts/... and build handlers via defineV2JsonRoute etc. Route detection = file convention (R); contract SHAPES are statically followable via imports (R reference) but builder evaluation needs runtime (I behavior).

The proxy's hand-written method list previously omitted PATCH while 17 v2 operations used it (documented in proxy comments) — static route/method inventories rot; the contracts are the source of truth. Any static inventory is I at best.
Proxy behavior is conditional on env (isAuthDisabled, isDev, isHosted, whitelabel hosts) — effective routing needs env → U without it.
